posts.trend: Can You Rent Your Way Out Of Loneliness? - India Today
posts.context: The rising trend of expensive co-living setups targeted at lonely urban tech workers.
posts.angle: Startups have successfully packaged basic human interaction as a subscription service.
slides: Terms and conditions for renting your way out of loneliness.

1. Friendship is guaranteed only during active billing cycles.
2. The community manager is not your therapist.
3. Organic bonding is scheduled every Tuesday at 8:00 PM.

If you do not attend, the loneliness will be debited from your card.

Auto-renewal is active.
posts.caption: Name the friend who paid forty thousand rupees to have "curated housemates" to ignore.
posts.rank_verdict: Slide 1 is a textbook title card that announces the joke instead of hooking the reader.
